subject: SIG follow-up: final artifacts needed to close MedTech SIG
messages:
From: Jane Miller <jane.miller@medtech.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Evans <tom.evans@medtech.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG: outstanding artifacts for SOC2 / pen test / ISO statement

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for walking us through the platform last week. Procurement is ready to move forward with the SIG but needs a small set of artifacts to close the record:
- SOC 2 Type II report (latest fiscal period) or SOC 2 attestation letter
- Pen test executive summary (high-level findings + remediation status)
- ISO 27001 certification statement or explanatory letter if in progress
- High-level security deck (customer-facing) for our security review

Can you confirm when we can expect these? We have a contract review meeting on Wednesday (8/5) and it would be ideal to have the artifacts before then.

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a short call if that helps coordinate.

Best,
Jane Miller
Director, Vendor Risk & Compliance
MedTech Solutions

Attachments: none

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jane Miller <jane.miller@medtech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T12:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: outstanding artifacts for SOC2 / pen test / ISO statement

Hi Jane — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Monica (Security Programs) and Rishi (Compliance) so they can pull the right artifacts. Quick status from our side:

- SOC 2 Type II: We have the 2025 Type II report ready; we can share the redacted pdf and an attestation letter by EOD Tuesday (8/4).
- Pen test: Executive summary is available; full report is restricted but we can provide the exec summary + a short remediation tracker.
- ISO 27001: Redwood maintains an ISO statement of applicability and a certification status letter for our managed control plane — we'll include the formal statement.
- Security deck: attaching a 4-slide customer-facing deck that covers architecture, data flows, and controls.

I'll attach the artifacts below and post a Drive link after we confirm redaction requirements (PII/PHI). If you prefer, we can redact sensitive sections and deliver a controlled copy.

Proposed next steps:
1) We share the artifacts for your preliminary review by Tuesday EOD (8/4).
2) If you need anything redacted, let us know specifics and we'll produce a redacted copy by Wednesday morning.
3) If an exec wants a brief sync, we can do 20 minutes Tuesday afternoon.

Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments referenced: SOC2-TypeII-Report-2025.pdf (redacted stub), PenTest-ExecutiveSummary-2026.txt (redacted), ISO27001-Statement-2025.pdf, Redwood-Security-Overview-Deck-4p.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Cc: Jane Miller <jane.miller@medtech.com>, Tom Evans <tom.evans@medtech.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: outstanding artifacts for SOC2 / pen test / ISO statement

Folks — upload complete. I've placed the artifacts in a controlled Drive folder and applied view-only access to external recipients. Summary of what's included:

- SOC2-TypeII-Report-2025.pdf (redactions: internal employee names & client identifiers)
- PenTest-ExecutiveSummary-2026.txt (summarizes scope, severity buckets, and "closed/in-progress" status)
- ISO27001-Statement-2025.pdf (Statement of Applicability + scope note for our managed control plane)
- Redwood-Security-Overview-Deck-4p.pdf (customer-facing architecture + controls slide)

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/medtech/SIG/2026-evidence
DocuSign/contract note: If procurement needs the SOC report under NDA, let us know and we can source a secure copy via our portal or DocuSign access flow.

Kimberly — per your ask, we redacted the SOC report for client identifiers. Rishi, flag if anything else needs filtering before we send the final copy to procurement.

Monica Patel
Security Programs Lead | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

Attachments: none (artifacts uploaded to Drive link above)

From: Jane Miller <jane.miller@medtech.com>

Cc: Tom Evans <tom.evans@medtech.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: SIG: outstanding artifacts for SOC2 / pen test / ISO statement

Kimberly/Monica — thanks, received and reviewed the Drive bundle. The materials look good for our procurement review; the redactions are acceptable. A couple of quick items:

- Can you confirm the pen test scope (external web + infra) in one line for our contract doc?
- Would you provide a point-of-contact for future compliance attestations (name + email)?

If you can reply to those two lines, we can close the SIG and proceed to final contract review on Wednesday. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Jane Miller
Director, Vendor Risk & Compliance
MedTech Solutions
